title: Smets–Wouters maintained model: fresh mode evaluation and shock decomposition
question: Can a published Bayesian DSGE model’s shock responses and posterior estimates be regenerated?

paper.title: Shocks and Frictions in US Business Cycles: A Bayesian DSGE Approach
paper.locator: Paper’s Bayesian estimation, shock decomposition and impulse responses; specific printed table cells/figure tolerances still require full-text comparison. Official replication archive DOI 10.3886/E116269V1.

source.license: GPL-3.0-or-later for this Dynare implementation per header; original data/archive terms separate.

inputs.description: Bundled usmodel_data.mat and usmodel_mode.mat from maintained author-derived model; first_obs=1, 230 observations, mh_replic=0. Official original archive requires login; correspondence not independently verified.
inputs.access: Maintained public code/data available. Official archive download redirects to login.

execution.result: Fresh maintained model evaluation and finite 40×9×230 shock decomposition completed. No original-paper quantitative comparison or posterior estimation claimed.
